articles.title: Proof Found: A Space Rock Hit the North Sea Long Ago
articles.summary: Tiny shocked crystals prove an asteroid made the Silverpit Crater under the North Sea about 43 to 46 million years ago.

articles.title: A Giant Stone Head of a Pharaoh Turns Up in a Yard
articles.summary: A homeowner's find led archaeologists to a giant stone head of Egypt's Pharaoh Ramesses II.

articles.title: Some Raindrops Can Slowly Wear Away Metal
articles.summary: Scientists found that raindrops charged by sliding over leaves or glass can slowly damage metal, even through strong coatings.
